justification: Inspected `test-shrinker/src/main/java/com/example/NoSerializedNameMain.java`, `test-shrinker/src/test/java/com/google/gson/it/ShrinkingIT.java`, `test-shrinker/proguard.pro`, and `test-shrinker/r8.pro`. The target is a small nested test fixture with one field and one explicit constructor; its outgoing dependencies are minimal (`Gson`, `GsonBuilder` only in the enclosing class, plus `TestExecutor.same`). Fan-in is also weak: repository references to `TestClassHasArgsConstructor` are limited to its declaration, one use in `runTestHasArgsConstructor()`, one integration-test assertion, and two keep-rule entries. This does not show the high incoming/outgoing dependency pattern required for hub-like modularization.
